:::{#hero-heading}

I lead impact measurement for YouTube's Business Organization, guiding a team of data scientists who help executives make rigorous, data-driven decisions about YouTube's programs and strategy.

My journey at Google began in 2019 on the Chief Economist's team. Before joining Google, I earned my PhD in Economics from the University of Virginia and worked as a researcher at [Mathematica](https://www.mathematica.org/){target="_blank"}, helping policymakers use evidence to inform education and health policy.

- **Focus areas:** Causal inference, Bayesian statistics, experiment design, and econometric modeling.
- **Writing & tools:** Author of [*Business Data Science*](https://book.martinez.fyi){target="_blank"} and creator of [Iggy](https://iggy.martinez.fyi){target="_blank"}.
- **Citizenship:** <span aria-label="Argentina" title="Argentina">{{< iconify emojione-v1:flag-for-argentina >}}</span> Argentina & <span aria-label="United States" title="United States">{{< iconify emojione-v1:flag-for-united-states >}}</span> United States

:::
